headline: Approved August minutes; discussed homeless outreach, Senior Center hours, and gym equipment grant needing additional $2,500.00.
summary: The board approved the August minutes and heard reports on staffing, a gym equipment grant needing an additional $2,500.00, and outreach services for unhoused residents including a planned fifty-bed women's shelter on Andover St. Councilor Juran raised concerns about Senior Center hours, noting it closes at 3pm and proposed staying open one night a week.

decision_evidence.quote: Approval of the August Minutes: First by Maxine Farkas, second by Andrew Hostetler, all others were in favor.
